Parse a SLURM Time String to Seconds

Source: R/utils.R
parse_slurm_time.Rd

Parses SLURM elapsed/limit time strings such as "MM", "MM:SS", "HH:MM:SS", "D-HH", "D-HH:MM", or "D-HH:MM:SS" (with optional fractional seconds) into numeric seconds.

Usage

parse_slurm_time(x)

Arguments

x

Character vector of SLURM time strings.

Value

Numeric vector of durations in seconds (NA_real_ for unparseable, "UNLIMITED", "INVALID", or missing inputs).

Examples

parse_slurm_time(c("05:30", "01:15:00", "2-03:00:10", "00:02:15.500"))
#> [1]    330.0   4500.0 183610.0    135.5
